prompt: A watercolor illustration captures a bustling school science fair. On the left, a girl in a blue beret stands beside a tall volcano model erupting with red paint. Next to her, a boy in striped socks points at the flowing lava, his mouth open in awe. In the center, a teacher with round glasses leans over a table, examining a glass beaker filled with bubbling green liquid. Beside the teacher, a small hamster sits on a wooden wheel, its tiny paws gripping the bars. To the right, a man in a yellow tie holds a clipboard, looking intently at a poster board covered in diagrams. Behind him, a woman in a floral dress hands a ribbon to a smiling child in overalls. Near the back wall, a black cat sleeps on a folded chair, its tail twitching slightly. A robot with shiny metal arms stands next to the cat, its lights blinking softly. In the foreground, a stack of textbooks rests on the floor, their spines worn and faded. Finally, a potted cactus sits on a windowsill, its needles sharp against the soft background. There is no digital screen visible in the scene. There is no fluorescent lighting fixture hanging from the ceiling.
